purpose: Preserve the research, experience and geometry decisions behind Route 3 so later edits do not turn it into a generic I-95 coastal drive or reintroduce the measured driving-cap failures removed during planning.
design_rules: Make the coast itself part of the experience by using four ferry legs, barrier-island landscapes and the Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel instead of treating every transfer as highway time.
Lean south for the warmest route in the first three-route set while keeping every stop in the United States and avoiding a Canada re-entry dependency.
Use one planned music night, no forced club night and no scheduled athletic/adrenaline stop on this route.
A hidden-gem option replaces an anchor; it is never stacked onto an already full day.
Every photogenic stop must also deliver architecture, ecology, engineering, folklore, art or history.
Ferry crossing time is displayed as travel time but does not count as active driving under the 210-minute bed-to-bed driving cap.

final_decisions.decision: Open through Old Lyme, New London, Orient Point, Greenport and Shelter Island using Cross Sound, North Ferry and South Ferry.
final_decisions.reason: The three short maritime transitions make the first two days feel like a holiday immediately and connect art, harbor architecture and Mashomack's marshes without repeating the Boston-New York interstate corridor.

final_decisions.decision: Use Asbury Park for the route's only planned social night, but leave the venue calendar-gated.
final_decisions.reason: Silverball and the boardwalk already work in any weather; a real rock or metal bill can then be selected 4-6 weeks before travel rather than inventing a generic nightlife stop.

final_decisions.decision: Layer Lucy the Elephant, NAS Wildwood, Victorian Cape May and an actual October ghost or oddities departure across Day 4.
final_decisions.reason: The sequence gives the group roadside surrealism, hands-on military history, architecture and folklore without adding adrenaline or requiring a long hike.

final_decisions.decision: Place Assateague golden hour after Berlin on the Cape May-to-Chincoteague day, not on the following Wallops-to-Norfolk day.
final_decisions.reason: The original Day 6 concept measured 284 minutes of road driving. Moving Assateague to Day 5 produces final baselines of 182 minutes on Day 5 and 199 minutes on Day 6 while preserving horses, dunes, NASA and the Eastern Shore.

final_decisions.decision: Sleep in the Norfolk airport/Military Highway zone after the Chesapeake crossing and use Richmond's West End the following night.
final_decisions.reason: Those lodging zones keep the full Wallops-Eastern Shore-CBBT day under the cap and prevent the Norfolk-Virginia Beach-Poe transfer from becoming an unsafe hotel-to-hotel run.

final_decisions.decision: Begin Sunday, October 11 at Saints Constantine and Helen Greek Orthodox Cathedral in Richmond before continuing to Baltimore's B&O Railroad Museum.
final_decisions.reason: The liturgy is treated as a real fixed anchor and the industrial-history stop still fits a 207-minute baseline day.

final_decisions.decision: Use the Mutter Museum followed by a quiet Metuchen Main Street night on October 12.
final_decisions.reason: Metuchen breaks the Philadelphia-to-Hudson transfer, supplies a low-stimulation evening and positions the group for Sleepy Hollow without repeating a large-city nightlife night.

final_decisions.decision: Build October 13 around a parked-car Sleepy Hollow cluster and the exact 2026 Great Jack O'Lantern Blaze date.
final_decisions.reason: The cemetery, Old Dutch Church, Headless Horseman site and timed Blaze combine literature, folklore, historic architecture and night photography in the route's strongest themed day.

final_decisions.decision: Keep Day 9 at 210 baseline minutes and Days 8 and 11 at 207 only with explicit live-traffic gates and deletion rules.
final_decisions.reason: These days pass the static road-network cap but have little or no congestion margin; the optional town walk or replacement is cut before the hotel arrival or Boston airport night is compromised.

candidate_research.selection_note: Each option survived person-fit, operating-hours, visit-date, coordinates and replacement-geometry checks. They remain outside the Magic score until promoted into the itinerary.

rejected_or_reworked_variants.resolution: Move Assateague to Day 5 after Berlin; final Day 6 baseline is 199 minutes.

rejected_or_reworked_variants.variant: Central Norfolk hotel followed by the full Virginia Beach and Richmond sequence
rejected_or_reworked_variants.resolution: Use the airport/Military Highway lodging zone, then a Richmond West End lodging zone.
Route 3 remains US-only; revisit international options only after written confirmation for all four travelers.

rejected_or_reworked_variants.variant: Adding an Assateague kayak, ropes course or other athletic anchor
rejected_or_reworked_variants.resolution: Keep this route at zero scheduled athletic/adrenaline stops so the wider ten-route set can use the maximum only where it is exceptional.

traffic_policy.routing_baseline: OSRM road-network duration without live traffic
traffic_policy.planning_ranges: Risk buffers are planning bands, not traffic forecasts.
traffic_policy.live_check: Recalculate every bed-to-bed sequence in live navigation on the travel date before departure.
traffic_policy.rule: If predicted driving exceeds 210 minutes, promote the documented replacement if it reduces driving, remove the day's named optional stop, or go directly to the lodging city; never assume congestion away.

image_policy.rule: External images are acceptable for the private planning prototype but must be licensed, replaced or removed before a public deployment.
